name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Sour 'N Sweet Pork Chops
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pork chop dish simmered in a rich sauce made with brown sugar, vinegar, and Worcestershire sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain excess fat from pork chops and brown them in a large frying pan.
Mix together water, brown sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and ketchup. Pour over the browned chops.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until done.
If desired, thicken the liquid with 2 Tbsp flour. Serve with rice.

_similar.keywords: sour sweet pork chops, tangy pork, brown sugar sauce

_similar.name: Zesty BBQ Sauce
_similar.description: A tangy and spicy BBQ sauce with ketchup, vinegar, and a kick of cayenne pepper, great for grilling.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Blend and bring to a boil, stirring until sugar has dissolved.

Refrigerate or freeze for later use.

_similar.keywords: BBQ sauce, zesty, spicy, grilling sauce

_similar.name: Sloppy Joe Squares
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

_similar.keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef

_similar.keywords: curry dip, spicy dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Maple Glazed Ribs
_similar.description: A sweet and savory pork spare ribs recipe glazed with a maple syrup-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut ribs into serving-size pieces and place in a roasting pan. Cover and bake for 1½ hours or until tender.

Meanwhile, combine the Dijon mustard, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, orange juice, curry powder, garlic, ketchup, green onions, and soya sauce in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the ribs and pour the sauce over them. Bake uncovered for an additional ½ hour, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: maple glazed ribs, pork spare ribs, sweet and savory
